messages.subject: very stupid problem
parts:
Hi everyone,

while I am quite an experienced R user, I am now starting to use lavaan, or at least I am trying to.
My problem is so basic that I cannot even run the examples of the tutorial. I get the following:

> HS.model <- ’ visual =~ x1 + x2 + x3
Error: unexpected input in "HS.model <- �"
> textual =~ x4 + x5 + x6
> speed =~ x7 + x8 + x9 ’
Error: unexpected input in "speed =~ x7 + x8 + x9 �"

I suspect it is a question of how to produce the single quote, which I cannot locate on my Swiss keyboard, and if I copy the code, the symbol is not recognised. 
Could anyone please tell me what key combination you type on which kind of keyboard, so that I can reproduce it.

cheers
Bianca

messages.subject: Re: very stupid problem
parts:
I think that you are copying and pasting it from somewhere that is automatically changing it to a "smart quote".

Word processors change "" to “”.

You can use single quotes ' or double quotes " in R - as long as they match up in pairs.
